description: This Java class 'MetadataFromSignal' creates or modifies Metadata objects based on MetadataHeaders from a Signal's DittoHeaders, used within the Eclipse Ditto framework for entity metadata management.

classes.name: MetadataFromSignal
classes.description: A class that builds or extends Metadata based on a Signal's DittoHeaders and existing Metadata, used for entity metadata management within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MetadataFromSignal with provided Signal, WithOptionalEntity, and existing Metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Builds or extends Metadata based on the Signal's headers and existing Metadata; returns null if no applicable entity or headers.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersToPut
methods.description: Retrieves the set of MetadataHeaders to be added or modified from the Signal's DittoHeaders.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Constructs Metadata from a JSON entity and a set of MetadataHeaders, applying rules for property overlap and leaf application.

methods.name: getMetadataBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MetadataBuilder, optionally initialized with existing Metadata.
